tr.th: Conclusion and Recommendations based on this report and previous findings known to us:

tr.td: The patient shows markedly elevated NT-proBNP, suggesting possible heart failure or significant cardiac strain. Hemoglobin and erythrocyte counts are mildly elevated, with low MCH, possibly indicating early or mild erythrocytosis or dehydration. HbA1c is elevated, consistent with diabetes or poor glycemic control. Creatinine is low, likely not clinically significant in this context. Other parameters, including liver, renal, and electrolyte panels, are within normal limits. No acute myocardial injury is indicated. Recommend clinical correlation for cardiac status and diabetes management.

display.value: Localized, primary osteoarthritis of the hand
